choices.label: Poet reads verse to the EX's turned back at the window
Opaque sodium Orange Haze eats the bedroom left-to-right
Poet steps forward; window slides away at matching rate
EX tips backward off fire-escape rail; Poet leaps after
Two bodies fall past 16 word-cards through slow-mo vintage party floor
Room dissolves to black; only the #5aa7ff blue vape ember breathes

I2_threshold.rule: At t=32.0s only the #5aa7ff blue vape ember remains in the black (q_end >= 0.88).

I4_signature_constraint.constraint: EX never turns around (view == back on 100% of frames); window_x tracks poet_x.
